content: We used bidirectional LSTMs for causality classification and causal explanation identification since the discourse arguments for causal explanation can show up either before and after the effected events or results and we want our model to be optimized for both cases. However, there is a risk of overfitting due to the dataset which is relatively small for the high complexity of the model, so we added a dropout layer (p=0.3) between the Word-level LSTM and the DA-level LSTM.
